title: Date night
intro: Let the evening drift from wine to candlelight to the stage, and end by the water.

stops.note: Start slow: a cheese board and two glasses.
Ask for the window table when you book.
See what's on. Comedy nights are a safe bet.
One more by the river. Zero-proof works too.

title: Kids' day
intro: Color, lunch, a run by the river and a toy store to finish. Naps not included.

stops.note: Cocoa and a croissant before the crowds.
Give it two to three hours.
Everyone picks a different counter, then you all share a table.
Show them where two rivers become one, then let them run.
The play table in back is free.

title: Family in from out of town
intro: Show them the market, the history and the rivers, then feed everybody well.

stops.note: On a market Saturday, start at the farmers' market. Any other day, coffee on the Circle.
The quickest way to see how Easton came to be.
Fast, filling, and picky eaters will find something.
Walk to New Jersey and back. Stop halfway for the view.
Booths for everyone, and breakfast for dinner.

title: Rainy afternoon
intro: Short dashes between dry places, each with something good inside.

stops.note: Lunch indoors.
Lose an hour in the stacks.
Try the listening stations.
Warm up with a pour-over.

title: Art walk
intro: Follow the creek, then the ink, then the conversation.

stops.note: Walk the trail and look for the steel sculptures.
Local photographs on the walls.
Thursday nights, print your own.
Talk it all over.

title: Night out with friends
intro: Pizza, a show and one more round. The river will still be there at midnight.

stops.note: Order three pies for the table.
Catch whatever's on tonight.
Last call is midnight.
